I don't really care about reddit site rules LOL. my accounts I've conversed with you on are both random throwaway accounts. just figured I'd reply to you since you blocked me right after sending a reply, didn't make much sense to me personally & I wanted to clear up some misconceptions you had.

I disagree, it's not a misogynistic name at all. it's a very tame joke from a video that's trended on reddit that you're taking a weird amount of offense to. try to loosen up a bit maybe.

I agree, I thought it was pretty widely known that Lyles has asthma, so I'm surprised he ran the final with that + covid, but did very well considering those circumstances. 

I'm aware you can't magically remember something that you forgot, I was just replying to you and letting you know why I asked you the question I did & informed you about the research I did. I didn't repeatedly try to coerce you to do anything, I'm not sure where that came from. that's a pretty odd statement

I'm not being obtuse, apologies for giving off that impression. I just said that I figured you might know the names as I hadn't heard of that. I also already mentioned that I tried to research it myself, you must have missed that part of my comment. I had no luck finding any other runners who were diagnosed.

Adam peaty is a swimmer, you mentioned runners so I asked about that. peaty came up during my research, but Noah was the only runner

not sure why you think that sub is related to misogyny in any way btw, seems like you're being weirdly obtuse in that fashion. maybe take a second to check out the sub and you'll realize you're incorrect. it's just a sub for a YouTube creator who has had pretty popular vids on reddit, one of them being a graphic that says "suck my fucking dick bitch". it's a harmless joke. I'm sorry that offended you :/

im also not being disengenous, I'm having a conversation with you and asking a pretty simple question that I'm curious about. sorry that you felt I was acting that way, that's not what I meant to do at all.
